channel.name: A&E CA
channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Kristin and Scott, who have retired early and are ready for a permanent vacation, are searching for their ultimate lakefront oasis; they tour a sleek modern home with a pool, guest house, and cozy round fireplace, an elegant estate with grand Roman columns and breathtaking lake views, and a contemporary marvel featuring custom millwork, a spa-like shower, and endless spaces to entertain by the water; which lakefront escape will be their perfect retreat?
